handbookNote: South Carolina Driver's License Manual, published by the SC Department of Motor Vehicles (SCDMV), 2026 edition -- official PDF fetched directly from scdmvonline.com at /sites/scdmv/files/2026-04/Driver's%20Manual.pdf (linked from the official Beginner's Permit page at scdmvonline.com/Driver-Services/Drivers-License/Beginner-Permits). The manual is AAMVA Model Driver's License Manual-based content adapted with SC-specific law citations (SC Code sections cited throughout). Full 12-section, ~176KB text was extracted directly from this PDF via pdftotext and used as the sole grounding source for every question in this bank; no invented facts, no generic driving trivia not actually in the manual. Exam mechanics: the manual itself does not publish the official knowledge-test item count or passing score anywhere in its text or on SCDMV's driving-tests pages (dmv.sc.gov/Driver-Services/Drivers-License/Driving-Tests) -- it only states the test covers 'traffic laws, road signs, and rules of safe driving' and gives a 10-question, non-representative sample quiz. Three independent third-party DMV test-prep sources (dmv-written-test.com, driversprep.com, permittest.com) were checked and all three independently and consistently report 30 questions with an 80 percent (24/30 correct) passing score for SC's Class D knowledge test; one of the three (driversprep.com) explicitly states there is 'no limit' on time (untimed). Because SCDMV does not publish this figure in accessible official text, treat 30 questions / 80 percent passing / untimed as well-corroborated by convergent independent sources but not government-confirmed verbatim. Content-depth rationale: the manual is unusually substantive for a 12-section AAMVA-model handbook -- detailed GDL stages (beginner's permit, conditional license at 15.5, special restricted license at 16, special restricted with waiver, regular license), a fully specified point system with exact suspension thresholds, DUI/DUAC BAC thresholds and provisional/route-restricted/temporary-alcohol license mechanics, SC's Hands-Free and Distracted Driving Act with exact fines, detailed sign/signal/pavement-marking catalogs, roundabout/DDI/RCUT modern-intersection content, No-Zone commercial-vehicle stopping-distance figures, and full sections on night driving, work zones, rural roads, winter driving, and trailering. This comfortably supports a large, non-repetitive bank -- 282 questions were written across 12 topic buckets, all traceable to specific manual sections, before the build pipeline's exact- and near-duplicate dedup step.
